title: Tensor, Hom and projection normalization for a cohomological comparison
statement:
Fix two correspondences $c,\bar c$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes with finite coefficients $A=A_{E,n}$, and a compactifiable cohomological pre-comparison $(f_Z,t_Z,\alpha_g,\beta_g,\iota)$ of [def-trf-cohomological-comparison]. Use its $j_Z,r_Z,d_Z,\delta_Z,\Pi$ and ordinary and exceptional mates, and the dualizing complexes of [def-trf-dualizing-complex]. All tensor products, pullbacks and internal Homs are derived. For each diagram arrow $g:U\to V$, write $T_g:g^!M\otimes g^*N\to g^!(M\otimes N)$ for the exceptional tensor map, the $Rg_!\dashv g^!$ transpose of projection formula followed by the counit. Write $H_g:g^!R\mathcal Hom(M,N)\to R\mathcal Hom(g^*M,g^!N)$ for its tensor--Hom transpose followed by evaluation. Barred versions use $\bar g$. For every pair of objects in the indicated finite-Tor constructible domains the following identities hold.

(a) Exceptional tensor compatibility:
$$\beta_g(M\otimes N)\circ f_U(T_g)\circ t_U\circ(1\otimes\alpha_g)=\bar g^!(t_V)\circ T_{\bar g}\circ(\beta_g\otimes1)$$
as maps $f_Ug^!M\otimes\bar g^*f_VN\to\bar g^!f_V(M\otimes N)$.

(b) Exceptional internal-Hom compatibility:
$$R\mathcal Hom(\alpha_g,\beta_g)\circ r_U\circ f_U(H_g)=H_{\bar g}\circ\bar g^!(r_V)\circ\beta_g$$
as maps $f_Ug^!R\mathcal Hom(M,N)\to R\mathcal Hom(\bar g^*f_VM,\bar g^!f_VN)$.

(c) Tensor unit and diagonal normalization:
$$t_Z\circ(1\otimes j_Z)=1_{f_ZM},\qquad\alpha_\Delta\circ\bar\Delta^*\Pi_{M,N}=t_X,$$
with $f_ZM\otimes A_{\bar Z}=f_ZM$ and $\Delta^*(M\boxtimes N)=M\otimes N$ [def-trf-external-product].

(d) Put $\chi:p_2^*\omega_X\to p_1^!A_X$ for the canonical exchange in the Cartesian square $X\times_kX$ with projections $p_1,p_2$ over $s$ (the leg order is the project's order). Its barred counterpart is $\bar\chi$. Then
$$\beta_{p_1}(A_X)\circ f_{X\times X}(\chi)\circ\alpha_{p_2}(\omega_X)=p_{1,\bar X}^!(j_X)\circ\bar\chi\circ p_{2,\bar X}^*(\delta_X)$$
as maps $p_{2,\bar X}^*f_X\omega_X\to p_{1,\bar X}^!f_XA_X$.

source.place: Lemma 4.2.2(a),(b) and Lemma 4.2.4(b),(e),(f), with the two projection indices interchanged
